d:
For a rescue dog, meeting a potential family can be the beginning of an entirely new life. At Villalobos Rescue Center, Tia Torres and her team help abandoned, injured and neglected dogs prepare for a chance at adoption. But will the first meeting spark an instant connection, or will finding the right match take a little more time?
Watch Pit Bulls & Parolees, Season 12, Episodes 8, 9, 7, 5, 6, 4 and 10, on Animal Planet India.
